page.overview:
Who is Alma Beoulve?

Alma Beoulve is a guest character in Final Fantasy Tactics. A member of House Beoulve, she is the only daughter of Barbaneth Beoulve and the full sister of Ramza. Through their father, she is also the half-sister of Dycedarg and Zalbaag, who were born to a different mother. Alma is bright and cheerful, but has spent much of her life in a monastery.

Alma's job is the cleric, allowing her to cast Holy Magicks to protect and aid allies from harm.

Alma Beoulve was the youngest child of Barbaneth and born to the same mother as Ramza, but a different mother to Dycedarg and Zalbaag.

Alma spent almost her entire life within the Orbonne Monastery alongside Princess Ovelia, becoming her only true friend. and Delita and Ramza had learned this from Ramza's father, Barbaneth, suggesting Alma may have learned from him also.}} At some point, Alma came across Virgo auracite at the monastery. Later on she returned to live in the Beoulve manse.
